//: The profile to use for a shareable test build.
buildType 'apk' matters: the default for Android is an .aab, which the
Play Store accepts but a phone cannot install directly. An APK can be
downloaded and side-loaded, which is what field testing needs.
The JavaScript bundle is embedded, so the app runs with no Metro server
and no network - which is the point of an offline-first screening tool.
Play Store submission. Produces an .aab and requires a real upload
keystore. Not used for field testing.
